in_marathi.name: Sambhaji
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born of Sambh, God of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sambhaji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit 'Sambha' meaning 'god of war' and 'ji' meaning 'born of'. Sambhaji is a revered figure in Hindu mythology as the eldest son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the great Maratha king.
